notes: DEGRADED INPUT: screenshots and ARIA snapshots only. The Bash tool was denied in this session, so `uie probe` could not be run and `uie findings validate` could not be run by me; the lead should validate this file. No behaviour was exercised by this evaluator. Candidates below rest only on static content of captured states (including the states the capture recipes produced: errors, expired, van, info-open, cancelled); every behavioural question is in not_assessable. Evidence paths are relative to the run directory (runs/20261016-230412-audit-standard/). Independence: the packet's journeys.json contains a `_comment` that mentions a ground-truth.json file; I did not open it or any file outside the packet, the role instructions and the named method/knowledge files. Note for the lead: in screens.json/aria.json the confirm slug is shared by the plain confirm route and the hold=expired route, so the index lists the default and errors states under the hold=expired route; I treated default and errors as belonging to the plain confirm route per routes.json.

passes.summary: Flow learned from routes.json, journeys and the captures: when (/) -> vehicle -> confirm -> done; read every state at 375 light, plus 1280 light for the slot grid.
passes.notes: No probes possible; no findings recorded in pass 1.

passes.summary: Element-by-element inspection of every route and state in the inventory against H1-H10 using the ARIA snapshots and 375/1280 screenshots.
Cross-screen consistency pass over navigation, step indicator, error summaries, change links, primary actions, terminology and status wording across /, vehicle, confirm and done.

out_of_scope: All 75 inventory controls (root 38, vehicle 19 incl. 2 error-summary links, confirm 14 incl. 4 error-summary links, done 4) were inspected statically in their captured states but not exercised: `uie probe` unavailable because the Bash tool was denied. USE-09 is not_run for this evaluator.

Per-heuristic coverage, every screen: H1-H10 considered on /, vehicle, confirm and done. Nothing found under H7 (walk-up flow used a few times a year; quick-day buttons already serve as accelerators) or H8 (no irrelevant content competing with the task on any screen) beyond the permit-field item filed under H5.

task_suitability.task: Book a slot for a car (book-a-slot)
task_suitability.evidence: Static path only, not probed: Saturday 17 quick-day button and slot buttons on / (root/slot-chosen ARIA), Car + waste checkboxes + Next on vehicle, four fields + 'Book this slot' on confirm, reference DR-204117 on done. Verdict is provisional until probed.

task_suitability.task: Change the slot of an existing booking (change-slot)
task_suitability.evidence: Mid-booking: confirm offers 'Change slot' (href index.html, no query), so a path exists but whether vehicle, waste and details survive is unprobed (not_assessable). After booking: no online path; see candidate 'No online way to change or cancel an existing booking'. Only route is a phone call on weekdays (done page text).

task_suitability.task: Book a slot for a van or a trailer, with the permit
task_suitability.evidence: Van / Car with trailer buttons and Permit number textbox present on vehicle (van ARIA). Not probed; permit validation unknown.

task_suitability.task: See the opening days and what the centre takes
task_suitability.evidence: 'Opening days' region on / gives days and hours; waste kinds are listed only on the vehicle step as checkboxes. Static only.

not_assessable: Hypothesis (H3/H6): 'Change slot' and 'Back to the slots' link to index.html with no query, and 'Change vehicle' links to vehicle.html with no date/slot query (confirm and vehicle ARIA). They may drop the chosen day, slot, vehicle, waste or entered details. Not probed (Bash denied).

Hypothesis (H1/H5): on root/default the Today button is pressed for Monday 12 October and slots from 08:00 are enabled; if the app's clock is 10:05 (journey start_state), slots already in the past may be bookable. App clock at capture time unknown; not probed.
Hypothesis (H1): whether clicking a slot or a day gives immediate feedback, and whether slots take a moment to appear without a loading indicator (journey persona note). Needs probe timing.
Hypothesis (H5): what 'Next' on / does with no slot chosen; what 'Book this slot' does on double submit; whether the Permit number field validates the DRC- format or is required for vans. Not probed.

Hypothesis (H1): in root/slot-chosen at 375 the Tomorrow button is drawn with a tinted fill similar to the pressed Saturday 17 button, while ARIA marks only Saturday 17 pressed. May be a hover/focus capture artefact; needs probe to confirm.
Hypothesis (H3): 'Another day' control behaviour (date picker or list) not observable from captures.
Hypothesis (H9): expired-state recovery: whether 'Change slot' from the expired state keeps the kept details and returns the user to the same day.

strengths.title: Error summaries with linked, specific messages and inline repeats on vehicle and confirm
strengths.evidence: vehicle/errors and confirm/errors ARIA: alert 'There is a problem' listing links to #vehicle, #waste, #reg, #name, #phone, #postcode with messages that state the fix ('Enter a UK mobile number, like 07700 900123', 'Enter a Dunmore district postcode, which starts DN'); same text repeated above each field; fields marked invalid. Helps first-time residents correct the form on a phone.

strengths.title: Confirm page shows a booking summary with change links before the commit
strengths.evidence: confirm/default ARIA region 'Your booking': Day, Slot '09:20 to 09:40', Vehicle, Waste, with 'Change slot' and 'Change vehicle'. Lets residents check the vehicle they will be gate-checked on before booking.

strengths.title: Entered details are kept when the slot is lost
strengths.evidence: confirm/expired ARIA: Registration 'AB12 CDE', name, mobile and postcode still filled after the 'no longer available' error, so a resident does not retype them.

strengths.title: Field hints in the residents' own terms with concrete examples
strengths.evidence: confirm/default: 'The vehicle you are bringing, like AB12 CDE.', 'For a reminder the evening before.', 'To confirm you live in the district.'; vehicle: 'Starts DRC-, then five digits.'; 'Nothing is paid.' Each explains why the data is asked for.

strengths.title: Quick-day buttons in residents' words and slot status in text, not colour alone
strengths.evidence: root ARIA group 'Day': Today, Tomorrow, Saturday 17, Sunday 18; slot buttons named '08:20 Few left', '11:00 Full' [disabled]. Matches 'Saturday morning' phrasing and the 'tomorrow or at the weekend' use.

strengths.title: Done page makes the reference prominent and says what to bring to the gate
strengths.evidence: done/default 375-light.png: 'DR-204117' as large text under 'Your reference', with 'Show this at the gate, on your phone or on paper, with something that has your address on it.' Suits poor signal at the centre.

strengths.title: Step indicator on every step of the booking flow
strengths.evidence: list 'Steps' (1. When, 2. Vehicle and waste, 3. Check and book) on /, vehicle and confirm, with the current step in bold in the screenshots.

candidates.title: 'Few left' slots are pulled out of time order and shown above the Morning heading
candidates.description: Slots should read in time order under their Morning and Afternoon headings, the order residents think in ('Saturday morning'). On the slot grid every 'Few left' slot is lifted into a block above the 'Morning' heading, mixing morning and afternoon times (on Saturday 17: 08:20 ... 10:40 next to 13:40, 14:00, 15:00, 16:40), while the Morning and Afternoon sections then show only the remaining slots. The accessibility tree keeps the slots in time order under their headings, so the visual order and the reading order differ.
candidates.impact: A first-time resident looking for a Saturday-morning slot may scan only the 'Morning' section, see 08:00, 09:20, 10:00 and three Full slots, and conclude the morning is nearly gone, missing six free morning times in the block above; afternoon times in that block may be mistaken for morning ones.

scope.persona: resident booking for a clear-out, first time
scope.task: Book a slot for a car

evidence.detail: Ten 'Few left' slots (08:20-10:40, 13:40, 14:00, 15:00, 16:40) above 'Morning'; Morning section shows 08:00, 09:20, 10:00, 11:00-11:40 Full
Same reordering at desktop width
Accessibility tree order: heading Morning, 08:00, 08:20 Few left, 08:40 Few left ... heading Afternoon, 12:00 Full ... (chronological)

factor_notes.frequency: Every day that has any 'Few left' slot, on every width captured; the slot grid is the first decision of the critical journey.
factor_notes.impact: Can lead to choosing a later or different slot than wanted, or to giving up on a day that still has morning slots; screen-reader and sighted users meet different orders.
factor_notes.persistence: Recurs every visit and for every day chosen.

candidates.recommendation: Keep each slot in its time position under Morning or Afternoon and mark scarcity on the slot itself.

candidates.title: No step says that the chosen slot is held, or for how long
candidates.description: When a scarce resource is reserved during a multi-step flow, the user needs to know it is held and until when. The context states residents do not know how long a chosen slot is held, and a captured state shows that a slot can be lost before booking ('This slot is no longer available.'). No text on /, vehicle or confirm mentions a hold, a time limit or a countdown.
candidates.impact: Residents often book while doing something else; without knowing a hold expires they may pause between steps and lose the slot, finding out only after filling every field on the confirm step.

scope.persona: resident booking on a phone while doing something else
scope.task: Book a slot for a car

evidence.detail: Searched all text in root default/date-chosen/slot-chosen: intro, Slots region, Opening days region. No 'held', 'hold', 'minutes to', 'expires' or timer.
Vehicle default, van, info-open, errors: no hold or time-limit text.
Confirm default/errors: 'Your booking' summary and details form; no hold or time-limit text.
Expired state shows the slot can be lost before booking: alert 'This slot is no longer available.'

factor_notes.frequency: Affects every booking; matters most for residents interrupted mid-flow, which the context describes as common.
factor_notes.impact: Losing the slot means starting the slot choice again after entering details; on a busy day the wanted slot may be gone.

candidates.recommendation: State on the vehicle and confirm steps that the slot is held and until what time.

candidates.title: 'Slot no longer available' error does not say why or what to do, and blanks the lost slot
candidates.description: An error should say what went wrong and how to recover. In the expired state the summary says only 'This slot is no longer available.', with no reason (the hold ran out), no link or instruction to choose another slot, and unlike the other error summaries it has no link. The Slot row now reads '— · Change slot', so the time the resident had chosen is no longer shown, while 'Book this slot' stays as the main action.
candidates.impact: A resident who has just filled in every field may press 'Book this slot' again, not realise they must go back to choose a time, and cannot see which time they lost when choosing a nearby one.

scope.persona: resident booking for a clear-out, first time
scope.task: Book a slot for a car

locations.snippet: This slot is no longer available.

evidence.detail: alert 'There is a problem' > listitem 'This slot is no longer available.' (no link); Slot definition '— ·' + link 'Change slot'; button 'Book this slot' still present
Comparison: field errors in the same summary are links to the fields

factor_notes.frequency: Only residents whose hold lapses or whose slot is taken; more likely on busy days and for interrupted users.
factor_notes.impact: Recovery path must be guessed; the 'Change slot' link is small inline text next to a dash.
factor_notes.persistence: Each time it happens; the state has no further guidance.

candidates.recommendation: Say the hold ran out, keep the lost time visible and link straight to choosing another slot on the same day.

candidates.title: Vehicle step does not show the day and slot being booked
candidates.description: Earlier choices should be carried forward so users can see what they are building. The vehicle step has no mention of the chosen day or time: its main content is 'Back to the slots', the heading, the step list, the vehicle and waste groups and Next. The day and slot are only in the page address.
candidates.impact: A resident interrupted mid-booking, or unsure whether the slot tap registered, cannot confirm from this step which day and time they are holding before describing the vehicle.

scope.persona: resident booking on a phone while doing something else
scope.task: Book a slot for a car

evidence.detail: No text containing 'Saturday', '17 October' or '09:20' in default, van, info-open or errors states

factor_notes.impact: Mild for most; a wrong day is only discovered on the confirm step.

candidates.recommendation: Show the chosen day and slot at the top of the vehicle step.

candidates.title: Permit number field is shown to every resident, before and regardless of the vehicle chosen
candidates.description: A field that applies only to vans and trailers should say so or appear only when needed. The 'Permit number' field with 'Starts DRC-, then five digits.' is visible in the default state before any vehicle is chosen and is identical in the Van state; the field itself does not say it is only for vans and trailers (that is only inside the collapsed 'About vans and trailers' panel).
candidates.impact: First-time residents bringing a car may think they need a permit they do not have and stop or call the helpline; residents with a van are not told at the field where the permit comes from.

scope.persona: resident booking for a clear-out, first time
scope.task: Book a slot for a car

evidence.detail: No vehicle pressed; text 'Permit number', paragraph 'Starts DRC-, then five digits.', textbox 'Permit number'
Van pressed; permit block unchanged

factor_notes.frequency: Every resident sees it; most book with a car (primary group).
factor_notes.impact: Confusion or abandonment for car users; possible wrong entries.

candidates.recommendation: Label the field as only for vans and cars with trailers, or show it once one of those is chosen.

candidates.title: Permit help sits behind an unlabelled info icon that looks like a fourth vehicle option
candidates.description: Help should appear where the question arises, with a visible label. The only explanation of the permit (what it is, that it is free, that it takes two working days by email) is behind a square button showing only an 'i' icon, placed in the same row and style as Car, Car with trailer and Van. Its accessible name 'About vans and trailers' is not visible on screen.
candidates.impact: A van owner who does not know about permits (declared gap) may not open the icon and learn only at the gate, or too late to get a permit in the two working days before a weekend visit.

scope.persona: resident with a van or a trailer
scope.task: Book a slot for a van or a trailer, with the permit

evidence.detail: icon-only 'i' button at the end of the Car / Car with trailer / Van row, same border and size
Panel text: 'A van, or a car with a trailer, needs a free permit from the council. The number starts DRC-. Apply on the council site; it comes by email within two working days.'

factor_notes.frequency: Residents with vans or trailers (a declared core group).
factor_notes.impact: Missing the two-day lead time can mean being turned away at the gate.

candidates.recommendation: Give the help a visible text label separate from the vehicle choices.

candidates.title: Permit explanations say 'apply on the council site' without a link or where to go
candidates.description: Help should give concrete steps. Both places that mention the permit tell residents to get one but give no link, page name or phone route: the info panel says 'Apply on the council site', and the Opening days panel says 'Vans and cars with trailers need a free permit.' Residents do not know where the permit number comes from (context).
candidates.impact: A van owner who reaches the Permit number field without a permit has to search the council website elsewhere and may abandon the booking.

scope.persona: resident with a van or a trailer
scope.task: Book a slot for a van or a trailer, with the permit

locations.snippet: Vans and cars with trailers need a free permit.

evidence.detail: Panel is plain text; no link node
Opening days region: two paragraphs, no link

factor_notes.frequency: Residents with vans or trailers without a permit yet.
factor_notes.impact: Task blocked until they find the application elsewhere.
factor_notes.persistence: Once per resident, until they hold a permit.

candidates.recommendation: Link to the permit application from both places.

candidates.title: Booking confirmation does not show the day, time or vehicle booked
candidates.description: A confirmation should restate what was booked. The done page shows the heading 'Booked', the reference DR-204117, gate instructions and 'Book another slot', but not the day, the 20-minute slot, the vehicle or the waste, although all were chosen in the flow and appear on the confirm step.
candidates.impact: Residents must arrive within their 20-minute slot with the booked vehicle; when they look at this screen at the gate or the evening before, they cannot check when to arrive or which vehicle was booked, and a wrong vehicle means being turned away.

scope.task: Book a slot for a car

evidence.detail: Whole main region inventoried: heading 'Booked'; region 'Your reference' (DR-204117, two instruction paragraphs); region 'At the centre' (one paragraph); link 'Book another slot'. No 'Saturday', '17 October', '09:20', 'Car' or 'Garden waste'.

factor_notes.impact: Arriving at the wrong time or in the wrong vehicle leads to being turned away; the reminder text may be the only other record.
factor_notes.persistence: The screen the context says residents read at the gate.

candidates.recommendation: Repeat day, slot time, vehicle and waste next to the reference.

candidates.title: Cancelled booking page is headed 'Booked' and still tells the resident to show it at the gate
candidates.description: Status shown must be unambiguous. For a cancelled booking the page keeps the heading 'Booked', and the red line 'Status: cancelled. This booking is not on the gate's list.' sits directly above unchanged text 'Show this at the gate…' and 'A reminder will be sent to your mobile the evening before.', plus 'Come to Quarry Road… and join the queue for the gate.'
candidates.impact: An older resident glancing at the large 'Booked' heading may travel to the centre with a cancelled booking and be turned away.

scope.task: Book a slot for a car

locations.snippet: Status: cancelled. This booking is not on the gate's list.

evidence.detail: heading 'Booked' [level=1]; 'Status: cancelled…'; 'Show this at the gate…'; 'A reminder will be sent…'

factor_notes.frequency: Residents whose booking was cancelled and who reopen the page.
factor_notes.impact: Contradictory instructions; a wasted trip with a loaded car.
factor_notes.persistence: Each time the page is opened.

candidates.recommendation: Make the heading and instructions follow the status.

candidates.title: No online way to change or cancel an existing booking
candidates.description: Changing the slot of an existing booking is a declared core task, and residents know their reference. No route, navigation item or control lets a resident open a booking by reference to change or cancel it; the only path offered is 'If you cannot come, call 01632 960771 on a weekday and we will free the slot.'
candidates.impact: Residents whose plans change in the evening or at the weekend (the declared times of use) cannot move the slot until a weekday phone call, and may book a second slot against the two-per-week limit or not turn up, leaving a scarce slot unused.

scope.task: Change the slot of an existing booking

evidence.detail: All routes and states searched (root default/date-chosen/slot-chosen; vehicle default/van/info-open/errors; confirm default/errors/expired; done default/cancelled). Navigation 'Main' has only 'Book a slot' and 'Opening days'; done page has only 'Book another slot'. No control or text field for a reference anywhere.
'If you cannot come, call 01632 960771 on a weekday and we will free the slot.'
contentinfo: 'Questions: 01632 960771, weekdays 09:00 to 17:00.'

factor_notes.frequency: Every resident whose plans change after booking (declared group).
factor_notes.impact: Task only completable by a weekday phone call; out of hours not at all.

candidates.recommendation: Offer a 'Change or cancel a booking' entry that takes the reference.

candidates.title: Waste has no change link on the confirm summary; 'Change vehicle' does not say it also covers waste
candidates.description: Each summary row should offer a change action named for what it changes. On the confirm summary Day has no link, Slot has 'Change slot', Vehicle has 'Change vehicle', and Waste has none, although waste is chosen on the same step as the vehicle.
candidates.impact: A first-time resident who realises they also have wood (as in the journey scenario) may not guess that 'Change vehicle' is the way to add waste and may book with an incomplete waste list.

scope.persona: resident booking for a clear-out, first time
scope.task: Book a slot for a car

evidence.detail: term Waste / definition 'Garden waste' with no link; 'Change vehicle' href vehicle.html

factor_notes.frequency: Residents who want to amend the waste list at the check step.
factor_notes.persistence: Every visit to the confirm step.

candidates.recommendation: Add a change link on the Waste row, or name the existing one for both.
